theorem_statement: Sharp rational Tate-transfer criterion for the balanced Z-model. Let S be a connected reduced locally Noetherian complex scheme in a smooth chart of the balanced genus-six degree-four Hurwitz stack, with no component image contained in the type-(ii) locus. Let p:𝒞→S be the pulled-back universal curve, L=W_5⊗ω_p^{-1}, A=P_S(p_*L), U⊂A the reduced-support locus, and Z=Ord(U) its finite étale right S_6-ordering torsor. Write Gr^W_16 H_c^16(Z;Q)=⊕_{λ⊢6} V_λ⊗M_λ. Then there are natural injections of pure weight-16 Hodge structures M_[6]→Gr^W_16 H_c^16(S;Q)⊕Gr^W_14 H_c^14(S;Q)(-1)⊕Gr^W_12 H_c^12(S;Q)(-2) and M_[6]⊕M_[5,1]→Gr^W_16 H_c^16(𝒞;Q)⊕Gr^W_14 H_c^14(𝒞;Q)(-1). Consequently, if Gr^W_{2j}H_c^{2j}(S;Q) is a sum of Q(-j) for j=6,7,8, then T_16(U)=T_16(Z)^{S_6} is a sum of Q(8); and if Gr^W_16 H_c^16(𝒞;Q) is a sum of Q(-8) and Gr^W_14 H_c^14(𝒞;Q) is a sum of Q(-7), then the [6]- and [5,1]-isotypic parts of T_16(Z):=W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Z;Q) are sums of Q(8).
